items.title: NEET UG 2026 — AIR 19202
items.summary: Secured All India Rank 19202 in NEET UG 2026, qualifying for MBBS and beginning pre-clinical medical education.
items.description: After rigorous preparation under intense pressure typical of medical entrance exams in India, achieved AIR 19202. This rank opened the door to pre-clinical MBBS studies and shaped a strong foundation in medical sciences, research mindset and healthcare systems thinking.

items.title: Preventive Healthcare & Precision Medicine Advocacy
items.summary: Published detailed LinkedIn analyses comparing preventive vs reactive healthcare, integrating AI predictive models and personalised plans for chronic disease prevention.
items.description: Explored how increasing screen time and sedentary lifestyles raise risks of hypertension and diabetes. Advocated regular testing + Predictive AI models trained on pathological data to flag high-risk patients early. Proposed personalised health plans combining diet, lifestyle, supplements and minimal medication. Highlighted differences between Tier 1/2 (lifestyle) and Tier 3/Rural (education + access) India. Emphasised economic benefits, doctor retention and better quality of life.

items.title: ABHA ID + AI Clinical Summary Concept
items.summary: Proposed an AI tool that extracts concise, doctor-ready summaries from Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) records to improve continuity of care when patients change doctors.
items.description: ABHA is a 14-digit unique health ID that stores prescriptions, lab reports, diet charts and special directions. Identified the gap when patients switch doctors and history is lost. Suggested an ethical AI layer that summarises ABHA data into an easy-to-read brief delivered at appointment time — saving patient time, improving care quality and creating organised datasets for medical AI training.

items.title: First Step — Free NEET Mentorship Program
items.summary: Launched a free mentorship program on Telegram sharing strategies to maximise NEET scores while protecting mental health, drawing from personal NEETard experience.
items.description: Having lived the intense pressure of NEET preparation, created 'First Step' — a free Telegram-based mentorship initiative. Focuses on high-yield strategies, time management, mental health conservation and realistic goal setting for future aspirants.

items.title: Healthcare Content Creation Journey
items.summary: Started creating content documenting medical student life, preventive healthcare ideas, AI in medicine and personal growth. Posted first Instagram reel and short video projects.
items.description: Treating content creation as a long-term learning journey and hobby. Documenting experiences, ideas on healthcare education, biotechnology, genetics and AI. Experimenting with storytelling through video shooting and editing. Aim to raise awareness and make complex healthcare concepts accessible.

items.title: Reflections on Competition, Empathy & Social Media
items.summary: Published thoughtful pieces questioning 'healthy competition', the impact of social media on attention span, and the importance of empathy and interpersonal skills beyond exam ranks.
items.description: After NEET results, reflected that life is not a competition. Critiqued over-emphasis on medals and ranks that can reduce empathy and storytelling ability. Analysed how social media (especially reels) shortens attention spans critical for deep medical study, and how smartphones actively demand attention rather than waiting to be used as tools.

items.title: Research Interests: Healthcare + AI + Genetics
items.summary: Actively exploring the intersection of biotechnology, genetics, AI predictive models and preventive healthcare systems in the Indian context.
items.description: Bullish on healthcare education and awareness. Focused on how predictive AI trained on pathological data can shift the system from reactive treatment to true prevention. Interested in ethical data use (via ABHA), personalised medicine and scalable education models for Tier 3 and rural India.
